def create(path,data,mode=0o400):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,mode)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'wb')as stream:

    assert path.read_bytes()==data
